{{Quote|Two stars, a red giant and a white dwarf, orbit close to each other. Zonama Sekot circles the third star, a bright yellow sun, which orbits much farther out, several light-months distant.|[[Charza Kwinn]]|<ref name="RP">''[[Rogue Planet]]''</ref>}}
A '''light-month''' was a unit of distance. Light-months were sometimes used to express distances between [[Star/Legends|stars]],<ref name="RP" /> as well as the ranges of operation for navigational beacons<ref name="FH2">''[[The New Jedi Order: Force Heretic II: Refugee]]''</ref> and [[Homing beacon/Legends|homing beacons]].<ref name="DN1">''[[Dark Nest I: The Joiner King]]''</ref>
